baseline.name: DIRECT_MARKET
baseline.definition: race-normalized inverse purchasable pre-race win odds at the preregistered snapshot

residual_model.zero_prior_start_rule: If horse_prior_starts=0, do not fit/infer historical residual from missing context; set raw residual score=0 for that horse, retain it in the full race probability population.
residual_model.residual_score_rule: For history-eligible horses, produce horse-level residual score from strict-history/context features only; then center residual scores within race before correction.
residual_model.candidate_probability_rule: p_i proportional to p_market_i * exp(alpha_race * clipped_centered_residual_i), followed by race normalization

uncertainty_control.rule: alpha_race is bounded, nonnegative, and weakens as preregistered pre-race market uncertainty increases
uncertainty_control.reason_numeric_not_fixed: No executable trial is authorized yet; numeric choices must be frozen in a new externally anchored prereg before execution.

required_invariants: alpha=0 implies candidate probabilities exactly equal DIRECT_MARKET
constant residual across all horses implies candidate probabilities exactly equal DIRECT_MARKET
all candidate probabilities are positive and sum to one per race
current market probability/odds are not residual-model features
horse_prior_starts=0 implies raw residual score=0 and no fabricated historical feature values
zero-prior horses remain in the race probability population
primary_future_gate: mean paired race winner-logloss improvement versus DIRECT_MARKET > 0
paired race bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
improvement positive in every preregistered eval month
no systematic market-rank flattening beyond a preregistered diagnostic tolerance
